name: Visible Zone Algorithm
aliases: Hall-Holt and Rusinkiewicz Visible Zone Algorithm
definition: A conservative visibility computation algorithm with incremental updates, developed by Hall-Holt and Rusinkiewicz [58].
summary: The Visible Zone Algorithm conservatively computes visibility by projecting primitives into screen space and retaining only those within a specified depth thickness, guaranteeing strict worst-case correctness unlike approximate methods.
